scope.purpose: Prove the narrow QA-only Rust-to-existing-external-WebView page-control path without changing the default WASM asset.
scope.purpose_zh: 证明 QA-only Rust 到现有外部 WebView 的窄页面控制路径，不修改默认 WASM 资产。

delivery.path: Rust ElementRef::post_message -> WebKit window message -> existing QA window.nsh.postMessage -> native QA on_message
delivery.path_zh: Rust ElementRef::post_message -> WebKit window message -> 现有 QA window.nsh.postMessage -> native QA on_message

whole_run.reason: The immutable Phase9 runtime schema rejected the new Phase10 event kind 'rust-webview-message'. The same raw run also emitted the pre-existing QA error 'Error: Production history replay did not apply' and reported resource_scope.complete=false.
whole_run.reason_zh: 不可变 Phase9 runtime schema 拒绝了 Phase10 新事件 kind 'rust-webview-message'；同一原始运行还产生既有 QA 错误 'Error: Production history replay did not apply'，并报告 resource_scope.complete=false。

limits: This is a QA-only page-control witness, not production Panel ingress.
ElementRef::post_message has no reviewed queue, delivery-error, ordering, or teardown contract.
No typed native OS-event sink was implemented or proven.
The sender is scheduled from the component body; no duplicate was observed in this run, but the one-shot QA receiver does not prove sender idempotence under rerender.
No G1-G7 acceptance claim is made.
limits_zh: 这是 QA-only 页面控制 witness，不是生产 Panel ingress。
ElementRef::post_message 尚无经过评审的队列、投递错误、顺序或 teardown 契约。
未实现或证明 typed native OS-event sink。
发送动作从组件体调度；本次未观察到重复，但一次性 QA receiver 不能证明重渲染下发送端幂等。
未声称 G1-G7 验收通过。
